entities.name: The Coil
entities.description: A system of 121 Nacatl laws engraved on a giant granite disc, broken in the Breaking of the Coil.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: A young Nacatl who formed the Claws of Marisi and led the uprising against the Empire of the Clouds.

entities.name: Claws of Marisi
entities.description: Anti-civilization Nacatl group who rose against the Empire.

entities.name: Pride of Judges
entities.description: Elite Nacatl group who enforced the Coil with threats.

entities.name: Empire of the Clouds
entities.description: The Nacatl empire that dominated Naya and fell to the uprising.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Feline people of Naya who followed the Coil.

entities.name: Antali
entities.description: Capital of the Empire of the Clouds, destroyed in the uprising.

entities.name: Binding Wall
entities.description: A massive white granite slab outside Antali where the Coil was inscribed.

entities.name: Breaking of the Coil
entities.description: The shattering of the Coil by Marisi and his followers.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara dominated by the Nacatl.

events.summary: Marisi forms the Claws of Marisi, an anti-civilization group.
events.quote: a young Nacatl named Marisi formed an anti-civilization group known as the Claws of Marisi

events.summary: Marisi rallies a huge uprising; cities are sacked and the Binding Wall at Antali is defaced and smashed.
events.quote: During the destruction of Antali, the wall was defaced and in some parts smashed.

events.summary: The Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fight for dominance in the streets.
events.quote: Soon there was open warfare in the streets as the Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fought for dominance.

events.summary: Marisi's revolutionaries triumph and the Coil is broken.
events.quote: In the end, Marisi's revolutionaries triumphed and the Coil was broken.
